verdict.rationale: Google documents an official Google GenAI SDK for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go and Java, and the first-party googleapis/python-genai GitHub repo confirms the SDK is real and maintained. The fine-tuning docs also show the same SDK being used for tuning jobs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs in use, and documentation depth on SDK feature parity and versioning across languages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
